forecasts.line: Chalmers doubts human-level AI will appear within thirty years but puts his confidence that it arrives before 2100 above even.
forecasts.quote: there will be human-level AI before 2100

forecasts.line: Karnofsky argues that a productivity explosion has a good chance of happening by 2100 and could quickly yield a technologically mature civilization able to send spacecraft through the galaxy.
forecasts.quote: a good chance of a productivity explosion by 2100

forecasts.line: Karnofsky puts about two-in-three odds on transformative AI being developed within this century, by 2100.
forecasts.quote: a ~2/3 chance it will be developed this century (by 2100)

forecasts.line: Kurzweil projects a thousand dollars will buy about ten to the sixtieth operations per second by 2100.

works.author: Ray Kurzweil
works.title: The Singularity Is Near: When Humans Transcend Biology
